questions.text: The exports and imports (in crores of Rs.) of a country from the year 2000 to 2007 are given in the following bar chart. In which year is the combined percentage increase in imports and exports the highest?
questions.solution:
Combined (exports + imports): 2000: 90, 2001: 110, 2002: 130, 2003: 130, 2004: 150, 2005: 160, 2006: 220, 2007: 230.

Increases: 22.2%, 18.2%, 0%, 15.4%, 6.7%, 37.5% (2006), 4.5%.

Answer: 2006

questions.text:
Most experts feel that in spite of possessing all the technical skills required to be a batsman of the highest order, he is unlikely to be so due to lack of requisite temperament. He was guilty of throwing away his wicket several time after working hard to lay a strong foundation. His critics pointed out that until he addressed his problem, success at the highest level will continue to elude him.
Which of the statement(s) below is/are logically valid and can be inferred from the above passage?

i. He was already a successful batsman at the highest level.
ii. He was to improve his temperament in order to become a great batsman.
iii. He failed to make many of his good starts count.
iv. Improving his technical skills will guarantee success.
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- i: he has not yet succeeded at the highest level [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] false
- ii: he needs to improve his temperament [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] follows
- iii: he threw away his wicket after good starts [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] follows
- iv: he already has the skills, and the problem is temperament [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] false

Answer: ii and iii

questions.text: Choose the most appropriate equation for the function drawn as thick line, in the plot below.
questions.solution:
From the plot: for y [latex]\gt[/latex] 0, x = 0; for y [latex]\lt[/latex] 0, the line passes through (2, [latex]-[/latex]1), so x = [latex]-[/latex]2y.

x = [latex]-[/latex](y [latex]-[/latex] |y|): y [latex]\gt[/latex] 0 gives 0, and y [latex]\lt[/latex] 0 gives [latex]-[/latex](y + y) = [latex]-[/latex]2y [latex]\checkmark[/latex]

Answer: x = [latex]-[/latex](y [latex]-[/latex] |y|)

questions.text:
The head of newly formed government desires to appoint five of the six selected members P, Q, R, S, T and U to portfolios of Home, Power, Defense, Telecom, and Finance. U does not want any portfolio if S gets one of the five. R wants either Home or Finance or no portfolio. Q says that if S gets Power or Telecom, then she must get the other one. T insists on a portfolio if P gets one.

Which is the valid distribution of portfolios?
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- Option 1: R gets Defense [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] invalid.
- Option 3: U gets a portfolio while S has one [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] invalid.
- Option 4: R gets Telecom [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] invalid.
- Option 2: R-Home is fine; S-Power with Q-Telecom is fine; U left out; P and T both included [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] valid.

Answer: R-Home, S-Power, P-Defense, Q-Telecom, T-Finance

questions.text:
Alexander turned his attention towards India, since he had conquered Persia.

Which one of the statements below is logically valid and can be inferred from the above sentence?
questions.solution:
"Since he had conquered Persia" gives the cause. So without conquering Persia, he would not have turned to India.

The other options add information not in the sentence.

Answer: Alexander would not have turned his attention towards India had he not conquered Persia
